verdict.rationale: The Voice Agent is API-first: the whole conversation runs over one WebSocket API. Agent configurations can be created and persisted through the Console API and referenced by UUID. The dg CLI covers account management, and a published OpenAPI spec exists, so the core of UI-equivalent control is reachable programmatically. Missing for 10: an explicit documented statement of UI/API parity, and evidence that every Console UI action (e.g. usage, billing, team settings) has an API equivalent, plus independent hands-on corroboration.
